reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's Daily Asset Statement for settled holdings of October 16 2026 is a dated, whole-book document: it lists every reserve category the issuer reports (U.S. Treasury bills, BUIDL fund units, USTB portfolio units, USD cash reserves and Fidelity Treasury-only money market balances) with units and market values. Dividing each category's statement market value by the statement's stated total for all assets (USD 22,454,002.51 on the T-bill page, plus USD 489,483.69 BUIDL, USD 713,286.81 USTB and USD 99,220.69 cash) gives 94.49% Treasury bills, 3.00% USTB, 2.06% BUIDL, 0.42% USD cash and 0.03% Treasury-only money market, summing to 100.00%. This replaces the previously undated composition-of-STBT liability-allocation weights (95.24/2.68/2.08), which were computed on a different denominator and could not close a common-clock composition gap. The composition is gross reserve assets, so the small surplus over STBT supply (issuer stats API: reserve NAV 22,873,412.20 vs supply 22,662,915.23 on retrieval) is represented inside these weights rather than as an unclassified residual. The statement is issuer self-reported with no independent assurance (coin level attestorTier remains self) and no named assurance firm; verification covers arithmetic and document identity, not third-party attestation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Matrixdock Daily Asset Statement, settled holdings of 2026-10-16 with the cash-reserve balance stated for 10/17/2026; category market values divided by the statement's total for all assets. Gross reserve book, not the undated composition-of-STBT liability-allocation column.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: None asserted as unlisted: the statement's four reserve categories plus the Treasury-only money market balance account for the whole reported book. Unrealized gains and accrued interest are carried inside the statement market values, and the small reserve surplus over token supply is left inside the categories rather than being reassigned holder weights. No independent attestation of the holdings was retrieved; the FallbackReserveFeed remains the only on-chain reserve reference.
